name: Liminal spaces
summary: Empty rooms of transit and routine: office corridors, pools, car parks and malls under flat light, with no people. A 2019 image of yellow rooms started the look, and the Backrooms spread it.

philosophy.core_thesis: An ordinary place with no people and no purpose feels strange: the viewer meets the unease of a threshold.
design_principles: Set the ground in a damp yellow (#C9B96B) or a dull carpet green with a slight grey cast.
Shoot or render empty rooms from eye height at 160cm, with a single vanishing point at the centre.
Light the room with flat fluorescent light and no strong shadow; the white point sits at 4000K to 4500K.
Add a low-grade capture look: JPEG blocks, a 4:3 crop, a 480p to 720p size, a timestamp in mono at 14px.
Repeat structure: tiled ceilings of 60cm cells, doors and corridors in rows of 6 or more.
Keep text rare and plain: a room code, a date or a sign in a default sans at 14px to 18px.
Leave 50% or more of the frame as empty floor and wall.
anti_patterns: People and faces in the frame

layout.grid_mechanics: A central one-point perspective: the vanishing point sits at 50% width and 45% height, and rows of lights and doors repeat toward it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 50% to 70% of the frame stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Strict centre axis; the UI text sits in the lower left corner as a caption.
layout.container_geometry: Sharp rectangles with no radius; thin 1px frames; a 4:3 viewport with a camcorder-style bar of 24px.

font_pairings.note: A plain, signage-like sans with a typewriter text face for timestamps.
An open Arial match for door signs, with a technical mono for the clock.
One mono face for a security-camera overlay.

hierarchy_rules: Set the room code and the date in mono capitals.
Set at most 1 heading and 1 caption on a screen.

color.palette_structure: Dull yellow, carpet green and fluorescent white, with a dark grey for the text.
color.contrast_rules: Corridor grey on wallpaper yellow holds 6:1; grey on ceiling white holds 12:1; teal carries only the pool and water cues.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, slightly dirty fills with a 3% noise and a 2% vignette; photographs look like a cheap camera.
color.light_and_shadow: Flat overhead light; no hard shadow; a faint hum glow of 8px at 10% near lamps.

materiality.surface_simulation: Carpet, laminate, vinyl floor, ceiling tile, tiled pool wall and painted concrete.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px grey line on frames; a 24px bar at the bottom for the timestamp.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; layers are separated by a 1px line; JPEG block noise at 6% opacity.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Plain outline icons at 20px with 1.5px strokes and square caps; arrow and exit signs only.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Empty corridors, stairwells, pools, car parks and mall atriums; no figure and no ornament.

motion.transition_physics: Very slow: a camera drift of 1% per second toward the vanishing point; cuts have no easing; a lamp flicker of 2 frames each 12s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover shifts the caption by 0px and underlines the link; active state cuts to black for 2 frames.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels uneasy, alone and held in a place between two states.

avoid_when: The brand needs warmth, people or friendly service.
The page must sell with energy and colour.
The audience reads long text in a calm setting.

modifiers.how: Add soft pastel haze, bloom and a pale sky; keep the empty space.
Add scan lines, a green terminal grid and split colour channels.
Replace the yellow with white and remove the timestamp and noise.

pack.why: A plain technical outline family that looks like signage and system icons.

ground.why: Liminal spaces stand on a grid of ceiling and floor tiles that runs toward one vanishing point.
